description: Every FK must resolve to a valid companies.company_id
Assets should equal Liabilities + Equity within 1%
Reported OPM% should match operating_profit/sales within 2pp
Document URL must be a well-formed http(s) URL
EPS sign should match net_profit sign
Total assets should be within 5% of BSE-reported assets
Companies should have >= 5 years of P&L history
Ticker must be uppercase with no embedded whitespace
close_price must be > 0 and volume must be >= 0
companies.sector must exist in sectors lookup table
